title: Endo-Correspondence Is Still An Open Definition In The Draft
body_html:
Endo-Correspondence Is Still An Open Definition In The Draft

The current TeX says that it will define a bijection

$$ \mathscr{EP}_{\varepsilon}^+(F)^\sigma \to \mathscr{EP}_{-\varepsilon}^+(F)^\sigma $$

and that this should give a correspondence between endo-parameters for dual pairs of classical groups.

The definition is not actually provided in the current draft, so the endo-correspondence is a missing definition rather than a result available for use. The exact endo-parameter definitions should be taken from the registered KSS source before this correspondence is finalized.
